project.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
project.subtitle: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed data products
project.author: Michael Seth Williams
project.business_problem: Operations leaders need one trustworthy path from batch quality observations and sensor telemetry to traceable decisions, without hiding rejected data, history, failures, or operating cost.
project.recruiter_takeaway: I engineered a reproducible Azure lakehouse that makes ingestion, quality, history, orchestration, recovery, performance, governance, monitoring, cost, and teardown independently inspectable.

hero_path.title: Two ingestion modes, one governed data product
hero_path.what: I designed a bounded batch and streaming path through ADF, Event Hubs, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks, Delta, and Unity Catalog.
hero_path.why: The diagram makes service purpose, trust boundaries, storage layers, and operating controls legible in one view.

hero_path.title: Reusable PySpark with explicit quality routing
hero_path.what: I separated Bronze provenance, Silver conformance, quarantine, temporal history, and Gold publication into tested modules.
hero_path.why: Thin entrypoints and deterministic contracts make the logic reviewable, rerunnable, and safe to evolve.

hero_path.title: A dependency-aware Lakeflow Jobs DAG
hero_path.what: I defined preflight, landing verification, parallel batch and stream ingestion, quality gates, Silver and SCD2 paths, Gold, validation, and evidence receipt tasks.
hero_path.why: Task dependencies isolate failures and enable repair without repeating successful upstream work.

hero_path.title: Lineage designed into table operations
hero_path.what: I use catalog-qualified table operations, explicit object ownership, comments, tags, and scoped grants to preserve inspectable lineage.
hero_path.why: A recruiter can trace Gold outputs back through Silver and Bronze rather than accept a diagram as proof.

hero_path.title: Controlled failure, focused repair, deterministic recovery
hero_path.what: I reserve one hard contract violation, capture the failed task, repair only the affected path, and compare clean and recovered hashes.
hero_path.why: The incident demonstrates operational judgment, not just a successful happy path.

hero_path.title: Three-by-three Spark measurement without cherry-picking
hero_path.what: I ran three baseline and three optimized executions on the same compute using a separate five-million-row skewed fixture.
hero_path.why: The broadcast plan was 39.009% slower by median wall time, and I published that result instead of selecting a favorable run. Spark Connect's unavailable task metrics remain explicit.

engineering_journey.title: Architecture and deployment
engineering_journey.summary: Subscription-scope modular Bicep, sanitized what-if, expected-resource reconciliation, and a live Trial-only deployment.

engineering_journey.title: Identity and security
engineering_journey.summary: Managed identities, Access Connector, resource-group-scoped RBAC, Key Vault isolation, and a successful GitHub OIDC validation.

engineering_journey.title: ADLS Gen2
engineering_journey.summary: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, and executed landing, checkpoint, quarantine, and evidence paths.

engineering_journey.title: Azure Data Factory
engineering_journey.summary: A parameterized ForEach and six successful managed-identity Copy activities landed 30,000 commit-pinned rows.

engineering_journey.title: Event Hubs streaming
engineering_journey.summary: Exactly 20,000 bounded messages reconciled through the Kafka-compatible interface, checkpoint, and Bronze Delta table.

engineering_journey.title: Unity Catalog
engineering_journey.summary: The live catalog applies managed storage, external locations, ownership, grants, comments, tags, and a column mask.

engineering_journey.title: Bronze provenance
engineering_journey.summary: Executed Bronze tables preserve source file and system, ingest and event time, run ID, record hash, and schema version.

engineering_journey.title: Quality and quarantine
engineering_journey.summary: Lakeflow published expectation metrics, routed invalid records, and enforced a real fail-on-violation contract.

engineering_journey.title: Silver conformance
engineering_journey.summary: Executed conformance enforced schemas, types, units, keys, joins, deduplication, domains, and idempotent outputs.

engineering_journey.title: CDC and SCD Type 2
engineering_journey.summary: Lakeflow AUTO CDC produced 647 effective-dated rows and passed the one-current-version invariant; the MERGE fallback was not used.

engineering_journey.title: Gold data products
engineering_journey.summary: Two facts, three dimensions, and one KPI output were published with documented grain, keys, lineage, and validation SQL.

engineering_journey.title: Lakeflow orchestration
engineering_journey.summary: The complete ten-task dependency graph succeeded on bounded ephemeral Trial compute.

engineering_journey.title: Lineage
engineering_journey.summary: Unity Catalog recorded live table and column lineage from conformed quality data into Gold outputs.

engineering_journey.title: Failure and recovery
engineering_journey.summary: A reserved hard failure stopped the real quality gate; focused repair preserved successful upstream work and reproduced clean hashes.

engineering_journey.title: Performance
engineering_journey.summary: Six five-million-row runs showed the broadcast plan was 39.009% slower by median wall time; result hashes matched and unavailable Spark Connect status-store metrics are explicit.

engineering_journey.title: Monitoring and cost
engineering_journey.summary: Diagnostics and the alert rule were configured; the data-plane incident did not fire the control-plane alert, Log Analytics had no visible rows in-window, and cost remained pending settlement.

engineering_journey.title: CI/CD
engineering_journey.summary: Local, security, IaC, bundle, publication, Pages, and a resource-group-scoped OIDC deployment validation protect release quality.

engineering_journey.title: Verified teardown
engineering_journey.summary: Exact-scope deletion, managed-resource-group handling, budget removal, and authoritative absence polling are executed only after evidence publication.

engineering_journey.title: Evidence methodology
engineering_journey.summary: Every major claim binds platform capture, code, receipt, validation, UTC time, commit, and SHA-256.

pdf_pages.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
pdf_pages.statement: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed, traceable data products.

pdf_pages.title: Trust has to survive the whole data path
pdf_pages.statement: Operations needs to know whether a batch stayed within limits, what changed, which records failed, and where every KPI originated.

pdf_pages.title: Two ingestion modes. One governed lakehouse.
pdf_pages.statement: ADF lands deterministic batch files while Event Hubs feeds bounded telemetry into checkpointed Structured Streaming.

pdf_pages.title: The evidence spans the engineering lifecycle
pdf_pages.statement: Provision, secure, ingest, transform, govern, orchestrate, break, repair, measure, monitor, publish, and tear down.

pdf_pages.title: Trial-only infrastructure with fail-closed cost gates
pdf_pages.statement: Subscription-scope Bicep deployed the isolated resource group and reconciled Azure service set after a sanitized what-if.

pdf_pages.title: Managed identity is the default trust path
pdf_pages.statement: ADF, the Access Connector, and federated deployment automation used scoped access without long-lived cloud passwords.

pdf_pages.title: ADLS Gen2 separates landing, checkpoints, quarantine, and evidence
pdf_pages.statement: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, and executed paths make state and ownership clear.

pdf_pages.title: ADF ingested six commit-pinned source files
pdf_pages.statement: The executed ForEach and Copy pattern preserves file-level transfer and activity evidence.

pdf_pages.title: Six files and 30,000 rows reconcile
pdf_pages.statement: The ADF run binds six successful Copy activities to 30,000 landed rows and byte-level receipts.

pdf_pages.title: Twenty thousand deterministic telemetry messages
pdf_pages.statement: Azure Monitor, the bounded producer receipt, final offsets, and Bronze rows all reconcile to 20,000.

pdf_pages.title: Explicit schema, checkpoint, metadata, append semantics
pdf_pages.statement: Event Hubs ingress, final offsets, zero lag, checkpoint state, and Bronze Delta counts reconcile.

pdf_pages.title: Governance belongs inside the data path
pdf_pages.statement: Catalog-qualified objects, managed storage, ownership, grants, tags, comments, masking, and external locations were applied.

pdf_pages.title: Raw does not mean unaccountable
pdf_pages.statement: Executed Bronze tables preserve source, timestamps, pipeline run, record hash, and schema version.

pdf_pages.title: Allow, quarantine, and fail are different decisions
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow published expectation metrics, routed rejected rows, and enforced one real fail-on-violation contract.

pdf_pages.title: Bad records stay explainable
pdf_pages.statement: Six quality rows and 17,144 telemetry rows remained reason-coded and inspectable rather than disappearing.

pdf_pages.title: Conformance creates a dependable analytical boundary
pdf_pages.statement: Explicit types, keys, units, domains, joins, deduplication, and idempotency shaped the executed Silver tables.

pdf_pages.title: AUTO CDC preserves history instead of overwriting it
pdf_pages.statement: The Lakeflow CHANGE flow upserted 647 effective-dated rows and passed the one-current-version invariant.

pdf_pages.title: Six outputs with explicit business grain
pdf_pages.statement: Two facts, three dimensions, and a site-product-date KPI table were published and validated.

pdf_pages.title: The DAG exposes dependencies and recovery boundaries
pdf_pages.statement: Parallel Bronze paths converged at quality before Silver, AUTO CDC, Gold, validation, and receipt publication succeeded.

pdf_pages.title: Gold is traceable to conformed source data
pdf_pages.statement: Unity Catalog recorded the live relationship from Silver batch quality into the Gold fact and downstream consumers.

pdf_pages.title: Traceability reaches the field level
pdf_pages.statement: The selected path maps Silver result_value into Gold result_value and its derived quality_pass flag.

pdf_pages.title: A reserved hard violation broke the real task
pdf_pages.statement: The deterministic incident failed the live quality gate on reserved_schema_contract and HARD-FAIL-0001.

pdf_pages.title: The platform named the violated contract
pdf_pages.statement: The diagnostic connected schema version 99.0-reserved-failure to the affected quality flow and input record.

pdf_pages.title: Repair the failed path, preserve completed work
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow repair reran Bronze batch and dependent tasks while successful landing and streaming tasks remained one-attempt work.

pdf_pages.title: Recovery is verified by content, not appearance
pdf_pages.statement: Counts, duplicates, aggregates, current-version checks, and clean-versus-recovered hashes all reconciled.

pdf_pages.title: A separate five-million-row fixture creates an honest test
pdf_pages.statement: Three baseline runs recorded wall time and plan hashes; Spark Connect did not expose classic task and shuffle status-store metrics.

pdf_pages.title: The justified optimization was slower
pdf_pages.statement: Three broadcast runs matched result hashes but were 39.009% slower by median wall time on the same compute.

pdf_pages.title: Configuration and observed outcomes stay distinct
pdf_pages.statement: Diagnostics preceded workloads; no Log Analytics rows were visible in-window, and the data-plane failure did not fire the control-plane alert.

pdf_pages.title: Cost labels state exactly what billing can prove
pdf_pages.statement: The $20 budget and stop gates were active; unavailable cost API telemetry remains PENDING BILLING SETTLEMENT, not zero.

pdf_pages.title: Every release travels through validation
pdf_pages.statement: Python, Spark, Bicep, bundle, content, accessibility, secret, metadata, PDF, Pages, and OIDC checks protect publication.

pdf_pages.title: The lifecycle ends with authoritative absence
pdf_pages.statement: Only the isolated resource groups and Part 4 budget are deleted, then Azure is polled until absence is confirmed.

pdf_pages.title: Inspect the complete engineering journey
pdf_pages.statement: Every major claim connects to platform capture, implementation, receipt, validation, time, commit, and hash across the repository, live case study, evidence explorer, and teardown record.

boundaries.databricks: Trial only; no paid Premium fallback
boundaries.teardown: Only the isolated Part 4 resource group, its Databricks-managed resource group, and the Part 4 budget
